integrity: The proof is a stand-alone exact arrowhead identity, two positive polynomial certificates, and a Perron–Frobenius argument. Rational replay checks are supplemental, not an infinite proof. No third-party full text embedded.
scientific_limitations: Finite symmetric positive-weight stars only; completed explicit classical RK4 end step, not stagewise or nonlinear positivity. An inaccessible plausible general positivity paper and unindexed equivalents leave priority risk.
title: Sharp RK4 positivity on heterogeneous weighted stars and a strict spectral-stability gap
